name: Marble Bath
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Paper marbling on a virtual water bath, after the art of Ebru and Suminagashi. Drop ink and watch every earlier drop yield into rings, then pull a needle, comb, wave or curl through the bath, and the colors follow - exactly, and razor sharp at any size. Plant ebru flowers, open cells with gall drops, start from classic patterns such as Stone, Nonpareil, Chevron, Peacock, Suminagashi or French shell, and keep marbling on top. Float a picture on the water to marble the picture itself, or switch to a seamless tile for backgrounds and patterns. Replay the making as a video, embed the living bath on your website, and reopen the layer later with every move still undoable. Fluid Lab adds a running simulation of inks, oils, surfactants and liquid metal to experiment with. Everything is computed in your browser.
